selectionContext.objective: Create the smallest coherent layout-forming wave after the saved gatehouse and operations block. This wave establishes a repeatable primary-road spine, legal turns, and a four-way authored plaza before any additional hero building.
selectionContext.selectionRule: Prefer reusable transit topology over landmarks. The first wave must connect, turn, and cross without a dead end or a structure placed on the cross-street.

deferredFourthJob.reason: The X/plaza supplies branching in the first usable network and directly addresses the known cross-street/plaza failure. The T junction remains the immediate fourth road-family generation.

sharedConceptRequirements.originality: Original MASSFRONT heavy civic and industrial science-fiction infrastructure. Reference genre principles for scale and function only; do not reproduce protected designs.

generationOrder.reason: The repeatable north-south spine is the highest-use placement piece and the calibration object for every later primary-road socket.

compositionRequirements: Road runs exactly north-south through the footprint center.
Show the full north and south seam faces without perspective cropping.
Keep a continuous 18 meter clear carriageway plus two 7 meter service/curb bands inside the 32 meter width.
Use shallow drainage, flush access panels, recessed cyan edge lights, and sparse amber hazard marks; nothing may protrude into the route or seam.

generationOrder.hunyuanPrompt: Use the attached approved concept as the sole silhouette and topology reference. Generate one original MASSFRONT modular primary-road straight piece, not a scene. Target normalization envelope 32 m X by 0.6 m Y by 32 m Z, Y-up, +Z north, origin at the footprint center on ground Y=0. Build one continuous 18 m unobstructed heavy-vehicle carriageway running north-south through X=0, with matching perfectly flat road_primary_18 socket faces centered at (0,0,+16) and (0,0,-16). Keep two 7 m service and curb bands within the 32 m width. Add restrained heavy civic science-fiction construction: warm-gray pavement plates, graphite substructure, dark contact strips, shallow drainage, flush maintenance panels, recessed cyan edge lights, and sparse amber hazard markings. Every curb, light, panel, decal, and drain must stop before both socket clearance planes. One connected source root only. No terrain, buildings, vehicles, people, weapons, turrets, biology, loose props, text, logos, cameras, lights, or franchise copying. Preserve clean low-relief surfaces suitable for later semantic materials, collision, navigation, and LOD authoring.

generationOrder.reason: A legal cardinal turn combines with the straight module to form perimeter loops, city blocks, and outpost approaches without arbitrary rotation or distorted road meshes.

compositionRequirements: Road enters from north at X=0 and exits east at Z=0.
Show both complete seam faces and the entire inner and outer elbow.
The center turn apron remains an unobstructed 18 meter heavy-vehicle path with a readable smooth fillet rather than a sharp decorative maze.
Drainage, edge lights, plate seams, and amber turn warnings follow the bend and terminate before both sockets.

generationOrder.hunyuanPrompt: Use the attached approved concept as the sole silhouette and topology reference. Generate one original MASSFRONT modular 90-degree primary-road corner, not a scene. No terrain, neighboring roads, buildings, vehicles, people, weapons, turrets, biology, loose props, text, logos, cameras, lights, random greeble masses, or franchise copying. Preserve simple semantic material regions and clean geometry for later navigation and LOD authoring.

generationOrder.reason: The four-way plaza creates the first useful district junction and supplies an authored no-plot intersection treatment for the deterministic cross-street placement failure.

compositionRequirements: Two 18 meter roads cross on the X and Z axes with four complete flat socket faces.
The center is a reinforced, empty, traversable 28 by 28 meter hardstand; it is explicitly a no-building/no-required-plot zone.

Use quadrant plate logic and directional light/marking cues so the X topology remains readable at RTS command zoom.

generationOrder.hunyuanPrompt: Use the attached approved concept as the sole silhouette and topology reference. Generate one original MASSFRONT modular four-way primary-road plaza, not a scene. Make the X topology readable from RTS command zoom through large plate quadrants and restrained directional cues. One connected source root only. No terrain, buildings, vehicles, people, weapons, turrets, biology, loose props, text, logos, cameras, lights, random greeble masses, or franchise copying. Preserve clean semantic material regions for later collision, navigation, placement, and LOD authoring.
